criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Reminder or Alarm
categories.definition: User wants to create, schedule, or activate a reminder or alarm.

categories.name: Manage Reminder or Alarm
categories.definition: User wants to delete, cancel, disable, or check the status of existing reminders or alarms.

categories.name: Control Smart Home Device
categories.definition: User wants to control smart home devices or appliances such as lights, thermostat, vacuum, or coffee machine.

categories.name: Get General Knowledge
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve facts, definitions, calculations, or general information not tied to personal context or current events.

categories.name: Get Personal or Contextual Information
categories.definition: User wants information related to their personal data, current situation, environment, or specific recommendations like weather, schedule, emails, or local events.

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: User wants to play, pause, skip, or control media playback such as music, podcasts, videos, or radio on a device.

categories.name: Send Communication
categories.definition: User wants to send emails, messages, or post on social media platforms.

categories.name: Manage Lists
categories.definition: User wants to create, add items to, remove items from, or check the contents of a list like a shopping list or to-do list.

categories.name: Navigation & Travel
categories.definition: User wants directions, to find travel options, or book transportation or accommodation.

categories.name: Local Search
categories.definition: User wants to find nearby places, businesses, or services.

categories.name: Get News & Trends
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve current news, headlines, trending topics, or podcast updates.

categories.name: Manage Contacts
categories.definition: User wants to add, modify, or retrieve contact information.

categories.name: Interact with Assistant
categories.definition: User wants to engage in social conversation, ask about the assistant itself, or play games with it.

categories.name: Control Application
categories.definition: User wants to open, launch, or manage applications or system settings.

categories.name: Manage Calendar Events
categories.definition: User wants to add, modify, delete, or retrieve information about calendar events or meetings.
